record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.context_brief: Optimal lower bounds for polynomial recurrence
record.original_question: Suppose p1, ..., pℓ are rationally independent integer polynomials with zero constant term and T1, ..., Tℓ are commuting measure-preserving transformations. For every measurable set A of positive measure and every ε > 0, must there exist n with μ(A ∩ T1^{p1(n)}A ∩ ... ∩ Tℓ^{pℓ(n)}A) at least μ(A)^{ℓ+1} - ε?

evidence.quote: Problem 17. Suppose that the polynomials p1, . . . , p` ∈ Z[t] are rationally independent and have zero constant term. Show that for every A ∈ X and every ε > 0, there exists n ∈ N such that µ(A ∩ T1^p1(n)A ∩ · · · ∩ T`^p`(n)A) ≥ µ(A)^`+1 − ε.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ be a probability space and let $T_1,\dots,T_\ell\colon X\to X$ be invertible, commuting, measure-preserving transformations. Let $p_1,\dots,p_\ell\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ be integer polynomials with zero constant term that are rationally independent (meaning that any non-trivial rational linear combination $\sum_{i=1}^\ell c_i p_i$, with $c_i\in\mathbb{Q}$ not all zero, is a non-constant polynomial). Prove or disprove the following statement: for every measurable set $A\in\mathcal{B}$ with $\mu(A)>0$ and every $\varepsilon>0$, there exists a positive integer $n$ such that
$$\mu\!\left(A\cap T_1^{p_1(n)}A\cap T_2^{p_2(n)}A\cap\cdots\cap T_\ell^{p_\ell(n)}A\right)\;\ge\;\mu(A)^{\ell+1}-\varepsilon.$$
artifact.category_tag: Multiple ergodic averages and polynomial recurrence
artifact.status_search_result: The question, posed as a problem on optimal lower bounds for multiple polynomial recurrence with commuting transformations, appears to remain open in general. Related results are known: for non-commuting transformations along rationally independent polynomials in two variables, a comparable bound has been established by Frantzikinakis, and various joint ergodicity results (e.g. for polynomials of distinct degrees, or under additional ergodicity hypotheses) yield the asserted optimal bound in special cases. No source found establishes the full statement for arbitrary commuting transformations and arbitrary rationally independent polynomials.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on multiple ergodic averages
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys recent developments and lists open problems on multiple recurrence and convergence for Z^d actions.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated in a survey of open problems on multiple ergodic averages.

status_evidence.title: Multiple recurrence for non-commuting transformations along rationally independent polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes a multiple recurrence result of the form lim inf ≥ μ(A)^{ℓ+1} − ε for related polynomial configurations under non-commuting hypotheses in two variables.
status_evidence.claim: Partial/related results toward the conjectured optimal lower bound are known, but the original commuting single-variable problem remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Joint ergodicity for functions of polynomial growth
status_evidence.snippet: Provides joint ergodicity results yielding optimal limit values for multiple ergodic averages in various polynomial settings.
status_evidence.claim: Special cases of the conjecture follow from recent joint ergodicity theorems.
